name: codex-model-workflows
description: Standalone local TrackWave plans and adaptive Sol, Luna, and Spark orchestration for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan local waves and route model work in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Durable local plans, dependency checks, attempt history, and model routing. Requires only Codex and Python 3.10 or newer; no server or external orchestration service.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use codex-trackwave to plan this work and sol-luna-spark-router to execute ready items with appropriate models.
